title: aloysia gratissima var. angustifolia
intro: Aloysia gratissima var. angustifolia, commonly known as Chilean guayacan or Chilean tea tree, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, known for its fragrance and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aloysia gratissima var. angustifolia include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Aloysia gratissima var. angustifolia include essential oils such as borneol, camphor, and thujone, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
